scenario.title: LaGuardia, Mar 22, 2026 — crossing clearance issued on runway 4 with a landing clearance active
scenario.t0_definition: t=0 is the Jazz 646 landing clearance (video 9:50). Negative times are earlier in the same video.
scenario.frequency_note: The controller was working two frequencies (he says so at video 2:49). The trucks answered 'LaGuardia Tower' when asked whether they were on ground or tower (10:15), so the crossing request and clearance appear to have been on the tower frequency. This is from a secondary source; the NTSB docket will settle it.

expected_flags.b: Truck 1 and company CROSS 04 at D t=40
expected_flags.explain: Runway 4 has an active landing authorization (aircraft number two on final) and a crossing authorization at Delta issued 40 s later. Both require the runway 4 protected area.

NEGATIVE CASE: takeoff clearance on 13 with traffic inside 3 miles for intersecting runway 4 is normal LGA intersecting-runway operation. The compatibility matrix must NOT flag this. Use it as the false-positive test.
